name: Of Dinosaurs and Pineapples
source: Take the lead of the Heroic Pineapple in his quest to live a normal life. Made with inspiration from the community, this is a game that will leave you wondering what the heck? [From [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/of-dinosaurs-and-pineapples]Indie DB[/url]]
translation: 带领英雄菠萝踏上追求普通生活的旅程。这是一款从社区获得灵感制作的游戏，会让你忍不住疑惑：这到底是什么？[来自 [url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/of-dinosaurs-and-pineapples]Indie DB[/url]]
